label: All-source actual paths propagate actual J1 to full J1
description: Propagate necessity backwards along each actual guarded path using only the selected-world J1 instance at each edge. All-source transport then makes every admitted-world existing supporter of a necessary concretum necessary. This new scope bridge does not hold from necessary-source paths with actual J1 alone: the offWorldContingent scope control retains those while full J1 fails. No reflexivity, source supply, WF or EM is used.
